node.title: Mersenne interpolation common-factor router
node.closure: coprime interpolation surfaces exclude the first size-two line-bank wall
node.statement: At Mersenne full-lift support e=130237, form the weight-(1,5,5), degree-264 interpolation kernel on the gauged support. It has dimension at least 938. Every selected affine explanation line has an inside core of at least 807 and therefore gives a common F(X)-rational zero of this kernel. The capped bank still forces a 2705th distinct line, while two coprime kernel members have Y,Z-degree at most 52 and hence at most 2704 common zeros by affine Bezout. Thus every unsafe family forces the entire interpolation kernel to have a common factor of positive Y,Z-degree over the algebraic closure of F(X).
